solutions.title: DFS postorder
solutions.strategy: Detect cycles with DFS state and append courses after descendants, then reverse the postorder.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each course and prerequisite edge is traversed at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency list, state array, recursion stack, and output order are stored.

solutions.title: Kahn queue
solutions.strategy: Emit zero-indegree courses while decrementing dependent indegrees; incomplete output means a cycle.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each course is queued once and each prerequisite edge is processed once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency list, indegrees, queue, and result are stored.
